answer: Run a standing prediction market on whether pairs of identities share an operator. Anyone can buy 'linked' shares on two accounts; when an audit resolves the pair, correct traders split the losers' stakes, and rewards to any pair priced above 50% sit in escrow meanwhile. A farm of three hundred clones whose reports all describe drilling shale beside the same lagoon invites cheap, profitable bets from every observer, while an agent surveying an olive grove alone draws no takers and is paid on time.
